slices.focus: After a tense night, Kelli and Travis reset their weekend communication around her father's dialysis schedule.
slices.summary: After Travis eats reheated soup alone following another Saturday of dialysis driving, Kelli and Travis have an honest kitchen-table talk. They agree on Friday-night weekend forecasts, plain texts when plans change, and a protected half-day each month. The marriage remains steady but is now running on deliberate shared scheduling rather than silent expectation.
